title: Frame
description: Generic header / body / footer container — the canonical card-shaped UI block primitive.

tool.name: mount_frame
tool.description: Mount a Frame header/body/footer container demo on the canvas.

parameters.flush: boolean — remove body padding so the inner artifact controls its own

props.name: header
props.desc: Top slot — title, action chips, status badges

props.name: footer
props.desc: Bottom slot — metadata, actions, secondary controls

props.name: flush
props.desc: Zero body padding so the inner artifact (chart, <pre>, table) controls its own

attrs.desc: Header wrapper (present only when header snippet given)
Body wrapper — carries data-flush when flush is set
Footer wrapper (present only when footer snippet given)
